name: Human Trafficking
description: Recruitment, transport or harbouring of people by force, fraud or coercion for exploitation, including sexual exploitation, labour exploitation and domestic servitude. Financial footprints include accounts controlled by third parties, payments for advertising, accommodation and travel, and cash proceeds moved through money mules. Indicators are signals for victim-centred escalation, not proof.

sources.text: FATF and APG, Financial Flows from Human Trafficking (2018)
FATF, Money Laundering Risks Arising from Trafficking in Human Beings and Smuggling of Migrants (2011)
UNODC, Global Report on Trafficking in Persons (biennial; specify edition e.g. 2024)
Egmont Group, public material on financial intelligence and human trafficking

indicators.name: Account controlled by a third party
indicators.canon: Account controlled or used by someone other than the holder
indicators.desc: Signs that a third party holds the card, PIN, credentials or device, or that funds and activity belong to someone other than the named holder.
indicators.ctx: Someone other than the account holder appears to hold the card, PIN or online credentials, accompanying the holder or accessing from a shared device.
indicators.fp: Family members, carers and partners may legitimately help with banking.

indicators.name: Multiple unrelated accounts opened with the same address or phone
indicators.canon: Multiple customers sharing contact details or addresses
indicators.desc: Unrelated customers or applicants share the same phone, email, address, device or bank account, including mail drops and shared accommodation.
indicators.ctx: Several new customers share contact details, often in accommodation used to house workers.
indicators.fp: Shared households, student housing and hostels create shared addresses.

indicators.name: Payments for online adverts and hotels or short-stay lets for multiple rooms
indicators.canon: Payments for online adverts and hotels or short-stay lets for multiple rooms
indicators.desc: Frequent purchases of escort or commercial sex adverts, bulk hotel bookings and short-term rentals paid by the same card or account.
indicators.ctx: Frequent purchases of escort or commercial sex adverts, bulk hotel bookings and short-term rentals paid by the same card or account.
indicators.fp: Hospitality and legitimate escort or event businesses exist.

indicators.name: Cash deposits followed by quick transfers to a handler in another city
indicators.canon: Rapid onward movement after cash credits
indicators.desc: Cash deposited is quickly withdrawn or transferred onward, including to another location or to unhosted wallets.
indicators.ctx: Multiple low-value cash deposits by different people into one account, then rapid onward transfer or ATM withdrawal.
indicators.fp: Group business or family collections can resemble this.

indicators.name: Wage or benefit payments immediately withdrawn by another person
indicators.canon: Wage or benefit payments immediately withdrawn by another person
indicators.desc: Salary, welfare or loan proceeds are withdrawn in full by someone not the account holder or sent to a third party on receipt.
indicators.ctx: Salary, welfare or loan proceeds are withdrawn in full by someone not the account holder or sent to a third party on receipt.
indicators.fp: Remittance to family is common after payday.

indicators.name: Customer appears fearful, unable to speak freely, or lacks own ID
indicators.canon: Customer accompanied, directed or coached by a third party
indicators.desc: Another person speaks for, accompanies or dictates instructions to the customer, who may appear fearful, scripted or unable to explain the activity.
indicators.ctx: Customer accompanied by a person who speaks for them, avoids eye contact, lacks access to documents or appears coached.
indicators.fp: Language barriers and shyness have other explanations.

indicators.name: Travel and visa fee payments for groups from the same recruiter
indicators.canon: Travel and visa fee payments for groups from the same recruiter
indicators.desc: Bulk payments for flights, visas and recruitment fees to a labour recruiter, sometimes debt-financed.
indicators.ctx: Bulk payments for flights, visas and recruitment fees to a labour recruiter, sometimes debt-financed.
indicators.fp: Genuine recruitment agencies charge fees in some corridors.

indicators.name: Business front for exploitation with revenue not matching staff
indicators.canon: Business revenue inconsistent with staffing or operating costs
indicators.desc: Reported revenue, payroll or resident staff do not match the typical costs and workforce of the stated business model.
indicators.ctx: Massage, nail, car-wash, restaurant or agricultural entity with cash patterns and many resident staff but poor payroll evidence.
indicators.fp: Small businesses in these sectors are overwhelmingly legitimate.

indicators.name: Adverse media or intelligence on trafficking network associations
indicators.canon: Adverse media or intelligence linking counterparties to criminal activity
indicators.desc: Counterparties, suppliers, respondents or controllers appear in adverse media, law-enforcement notices or intelligence connected to financial crime, abuse, forced labour or organised crime.
indicators.ctx: Customer or counterparties named in credible reports or law enforcement requests relating to trafficking.
